neighbours.label: Spelling unit: the 'al'/'ual' word piece completing a '-cephal-' stem (encephalitis, encephalopathy, electroencephalogram, cephalic, cephalopod; also German Enzephal-, Russian энцефал-) or 'conceptual' (conceptually, conceptualize); meaning-independent, not 'concept' alone and not other -al/-ual words (actual, contextual, perceptual, spinal, neural)
fire: Doctors suspected viral encephalitis when the fever spiked.
The electroencephalogram recorded unusual spikes overnight.
Blood was drawn from the cephalic vein in her forearm.
The octopus is a clever cephalopod that can open jars.
Hepatic encephalopathy can cause confusion in liver patients.
The paper offers a conceptual framework for climate risk.
Conceptually, the two theories are very similar.
Die Enzephalitis wurde durch Zecken übertragen.
quiet: Doctors suspected viral meningitis when the fever spiked.
The electrocardiogram recorded unusual spikes overnight.
Blood was drawn from the basilic vein in her forearm.
The octopus is a clever mollusc that can open jars.
Hepatic failure can cause confusion in liver patients.
The paper offers a contextual framework for climate risk.
Actually, the two theories are very similar.
Die Meningitis wurde durch Zecken übertragen.
